bottom_line: JELD-WEN Builders Series represents entry-level construction with mixed performance indicators. Steel models feature LVL wood frame construction with galvanized steel skin and epoxy corrosion protection, while fiberglass models use BASF Neopore foam core. Energy performance varies significantly by glazing (U-factors 0.15-0.43), with Low-E argon achieving 0.20-0.27 range. Critical gaps exist in hardware specifications, weatherstripping materials, and long-term durability data.

Factory primer application and corrosion protection indicate baseline quality standards.
scoring_notes.durability: Mixed indicators. Positive: LVL construction resists warping, epoxy primer prevents steel corrosion, galvanized steel skin. Concerns: No disclosed weatherstripping replacement intervals, foam wedge sealing system may require maintenance, unclear hardware grades. Limited long-term performance data available.

Weathersealing system appears adequate but lacks material specifications. Multi-point locking unclear for entry doors despite availability on patio doors.
